nodes.description: Source code fetched from IPFS

nodes.description: Source code matches deployed contract

external_entities.name: Verification Tool
external_entities.description: Block explorer or verification service requesting source verification

ambiguities.text: Encoding left to compilers (currently CBOR by Solidity/Vyper)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume metadata content encoding is opaque to the protocol. Verification tools must implement multiple decoders or accept compiler hints about encoding format.

ambiguities.text: No validation rules specified for metadata content itself
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume metadata content is arbitrary bytes with no protocol-level validation. Consumers must handle malformed or unexpected content gracefully.

ambiguities.text: No specific error conditions are defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume validation failures during EOF parsing (including metadata section) result in deployment rejection with generic error.

implicit_assumptions.description: Metadata content accurately represents compiler version and source references
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious actors could embed false metadata pointing to incorrect source code, misleading verification tools and users

implicit_assumptions.description: IPFS content referenced in metadata remains available
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Source verification becomes impossible if IPFS content is garbage collected or unavailable

implicit_assumptions.description: Metadata changes do not affect contract execution behavior
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If metadata is somehow reachable by code, it could introduce non-determinism or unexpected behavior
